name: Aspartame
aliases: E951, aspartame, aspartyl phenylalanine methyl ester, aspartamo
what_is: An intense synthetic sweetener approximately 200 times sweeter than sugar.
why_botia: It flags it because it requires a mandatory warning for phenylketonurics (contains phenylalanine) and represents a marker of ultra-processed foods (NOVA Group 4).
can_1: Identify E951 or Aspartame and flag the mandatory warning 'contains a source of phenylalanine'.
can_2: Classify the product as ultra-processed under the NOVA system.
cannot_1: Measure the exact milligrams of aspartame added to the formulation.
cannot_2: Verify if the aspartame has begun to degrade into diketopiperazine under high-temperature storage.
title: Aspartame
description: An intense synthetic sweetener approximately 200 times sweeter than sugar.
